thread_subject: SVMC Nursing Ratio Violations — Union Grievance Timeline

emails.body: Dear Ms. Chen, The union has documented nurse-to-patient ratio violations at SVMC dating back to OCTOBER 2023 — a full year before the recent CDPH inspection. Our records show Med/Surg night shift violations beginning October 12, 2023. We are attaching historical staffing records. This is not a recent crisis — it is a systemic failure. We demand full disclosure and retroactive penalty assessment. The attached 2023-10 on-call list (v2023-10) shows inadequate float pool coverage was already evident a year ago.

Mr. Torres, We dispute the characterization of these violations as dating back to October 2023. Our internal records show compliant staffing during that period. The union's 2023 on-call list attachment references ARCHIVED data (v2023-10) that was superseded. CDPH's current inspection covers only October 2024 violations. We are not conceding a 12-month violation history.

For your reference: the 2023-10 on-call list we attached shows that Carol Adams (RN-TEL-OLD-01), Pete Murray (RN-SD-OLD-01), and Amanda Price (RN-MS-OLD-01) were listed as available — all three have since departed. This 33% attrition of the on-call pool is precisely what caused the 2024 violations. Using the 2023 roster to claim adequacy is inappropriate — the CURRENT on-call list must be used.
